Family memberships include enrollment for each child in one swim lesson per session. We offer 4 2-week sessions throughout the summer with lessons running every day from Monday through Thursday, totaling 8 lessons per session. Swim lessons at Seminole emphasize water safety and skill development, while growing a lifelong love of swimming. services.desc: Please enter your username or email address. You will receive a link to create a new password via email. Seminole Pool’s Water Ballet program is open to all who want to combine the grace of dance with the joy of swimming. Participants can explore the freedom of underwater movement, learn synchronized routines, and develop their coordination and strength while having a blast in the water. There is no minimum age requirement but we do ask that kids have passed out of Level 4 in Swim Lessons before they sign up. 2026 Sign up for Water Ballet is now open in your Member Splash account. Once performance groups are formed, your child will have class for 30 minutes every Monday and Wednesday.
